fetch_openml_mnist: fetch the MNIST 784 dataset from OpenML with return_X_y=True and as_frame=False
train_logistic_regression_l1: train a multinomial logistic regression with L1 penalty using the SAGA solver on scaled features
split_train_test_dataset: split a dataset into training and test sets with specified train_size and test_size
scale_features_standard: fit a StandardScaler on training data and transform both training and test data
check_random_state_permute: create a reproducible random state and permute dataset indices for shuffling
